title: Bosch Series 6 Dishwasher SMS6HCI02A $1146 Delivered + Free Removal of Your Old Dishwasher @ Home Clearance (Excl. TAS, NT)
body:
Deal: Bosch Series 6 Dishwasher SMS6HCI02A $1146 Delivered + Free Removal of Your Old Dishwasher @ Home Clearance (Excl. TAS, NT)

[dogboy] Before anyone asks - yes, this is the one with the cutlery drawer!
[Averell] I bought the version with the cutlery rack, which was about $70 more than the one without. We used it twice, amd then removed it permanently. The kids prefer the basket.
[FTTNope] same, I chose the one without the cutlery drawer because it has too much impact on vertical space
[IlIlIl IlI llIIIl] The cutlery draw is junk. Eats into space and the cutlery doesn't get washed well even on pots and pans mode.
[placard] Agreed, I hate the cutlery drawer! Takes up so much room and lowers available headroom for the top normal shelf.
I chose a Bosch with the cutlery basket and it's so easy to just chuck cutlery in, or remove the entire basket it you want larger items instead.
[steviekfc] I have a serie 8 ( https://www.bosch-home.com.au/en/mkt-product/SMS8EDI01A#/Tog… ) and hate it. Barely fits a dinner plate and the front looks like it's rusting behind the plastic like coating on the door.
[ReaperX22] I don't know if yours has it; but most of the top(middle? racks) can be adjusted up/down. By default they're usually in their lowest positions and will clash with taller plates from the lower rack. May be worth checking if you can adjust yours up a notch? Though in the past I've found that can compromise taller glasses in the top rack if there's a cutlery rack also above it.
(Edit; checked the manual from your link, page 21 shows it does but dunno if that helps at all/you may have already tried it)
[steviekfc] Thanks mate. Yeah it's at its top setting already. One of the negative reviews I read on it before I bought it was someone saying it didn't fit their Australian plates and I thought yeah right and bought it anyway. I should have listened haha.
Thanks heaps for your help though mate you're a legend.
[razdi] Yeah this is a known downside of the series 8, this is one of the reasons I went with the series 6.
[IlIlIl IlI llIIIl] My Serie 6 purchased Nov 2021 now has developed a leak. On a positive side I know the leak detector and safeguard works. But now I can't run a wash in Pots and Pans or Eco Mode without it triggering a leak. Fortunately I downloaded a new program via the app to do a quick 55min 45C wash and it seems to be holding up so far.
Trying now to get it fixed under ACL.
[hutcho] Does anyone else hate stainless steel appliances?
[Meconium] Is that because they're some plastic wrap and not stainless steel? Unlikely that about 1% chromium in 99%ish iron could make it completely lose ferromagneticity, I would have thought?
[mysterybox] Will TGG price beat? As I am thinking of adding TGG 5yr gold service extra.
[Meconium] Why not ask TGG if they will price beat, because then you are testing if their 5yr gold service is worth extra.
[Ads] I bought a SMU6HAS01A (basket) in the last 6 months to replace another 10+ year old Bosch. Whilst its fine, the touch buttons on it are trash. They are slow to react and require more force than you expect. This one at least looks like it has physical buttons.
Granted this is 99% of dishwashers atm, as much as I connect everything to HA, I see little point in it being internet connected. Maybe it would be great if I could load it up with a weeks worth of washing tablets/powder and it could go when it decided it was full. But you are still putting one tablet in at a time like its 1999. The dishwasher screen doesn't even tell you itself when its out of rinse aid.
On the plus side, it washes dishes great.
[IlIlIl IlI llIIIl] True but the downloadable programs is something I just discovered and it's allowed me to run a wash without it leaking.
